{{Quote|All I can tell you is that a situation has arisen that might have the most serious consequences for the inhabitants of the Seswenna sector, Senator.|[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Shayla Paige-Tarkin]]|<ref name="Jedi Trial">''[[Jedi Trial]]''</ref>}}
The '''Seswenna sector''' {{Pronounced|sɪs.wɪnˌnɑ}} was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] at the intersection of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] and the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], [[Seswenna/Legends|Seswenna]] itself, [[Adras]], [[Agomar]], [[Brintooin]], [[Dzass IV]], [[Eczar]], [[Luptoom]], [[Mirnic system/Legends|Mirnic]], [[Orryxia]], [[Parwa/Legends|Parwa]], [[Hockaleg]], [[Phelarion/Legends|Phelarion]], [[Spuma]], [[Uvena Prime/Legends|Uvena Prime]], and [[Uvena III]]; it also contained the [[Moshaw Dark Star]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] was built in the sector.

==History==
{{Quote|After the Sith offensive seized the Seswenna sector of the Outer Rim, the Imperial armada tuned its sights closer to the Core.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]]|audio=TheMidRim-Timeline5.flac|<ref name="Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui|int=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui}}</ref>}}
[[File:Seswenna_sector_EAOC.jpg|thumb|left|230px|The Seswenna sector and its surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]]]
The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] conquered the entire Seswenna sector during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] conquest of the Seswenna sector made [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] citizens and soldiers lose all hope in the Republic's survival until the [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|Battle of Bothawui]].<ref name="Timeline5" />

[[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]] and later [[Shayla Paige-Tarkin]] represented the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. During the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Seswenna sector was a part of [[Oversector Outer]]. The sector's capital was [[Eriadu City/Legends|Eriadu City]] on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. The sector bordered [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]].

It was hinted that the sector only joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] after [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin's]] birth ([[64 BBY/Legends|64 BBY]]). At any point, the sector was different from most other ones in the Republic, in that it was ruled by a [[Governor/Legends|governor]] and [[Lieutenant governor/Legends|lieutenant governor]] appointed by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], as opposed to a domestic government. The governor/lieutenant governor of the sector simultaneously served as the governor/lieutenant of [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. During the last century of the Galactic Republic, [[Ulm Brashere]] represented the Seswenna sector in the Galactic Senate.<ref name="TEGtW" />

[[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] began his political career serving as the sector's lieutenant governor; at some point after [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] became [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], he was made first governor, then [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the sector, and later [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of [[Oversector Outer]]. After his death at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Ardus Kaine]] became the successor of Wilhuff Tarkin as Grand Moff of Oversector Outer.

The [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] [[Tarkin (superweapon)|Tarkin]] was built in the sector in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] over the planet [[Hockaleg]] and was destroyed there in the same year by a Rebel commando team led by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ardus Kaine]] transferred the capital of Oversector Outer from Eriadu to [[Entralla/Legends|Entralla]] and founded his own [[Pentastar Alignment|empire]] in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]]. Soon after, Eriadu became the capital of the [[Eriadu Authority]], an Imperial faction established by [[Superior General]] [[Sander Delvardus]], and the Seswenna sector his core territory. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], Delvardus was [[Battle of Sullust (Delvardus campaign)|defeated]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and fled to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] with his remaining forces. The sector eventually rejoined the loyal Imperial forces.<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the sector aligned with the [[Confederation]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] incorrectly places [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]], [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], [[Ghorman/Legends|Ghorman]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Corsin/Legends|Corsin]], [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], and [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]] in the Seswenna sector. Yaga Minor is in the [[Prefsbelt sector/Legends|Prefsbelt sector]]; Chandrila is in the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]]; [[Corsin/Legends|Corsin]] is in the [[Ploo sector/Legends|Ploo sector]]; Ghorman is in the [[Sern sector/Legends|Sern sector]]; Coruscant is in the [[Coruscant sector/Legends|Coruscant sector]]; Balmorra is in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].

Additionally, ''Rebellion'' incorrectly places the sector at the heart of the Galactic Core, and both it and ''[[Star Wars: Rebellion: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' mistakenly spell it as "Sesswenna Sector." It is also mistakenly spelled "Seswanna" in ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''.

The name of the sector was first pronounced in ''[[Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui]]''.
